issue_context.title: HomeKit: Unable to include/exclude some lights
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have a HomeKit bridge defined for the Lights domain. After I installed the latest version, I was keen to rectify the issue with some of my lights have both `RGB` and `Temperature` accessories.

I used the the `Configure` option from the HomeKit instances in Configuration>Integrations. When I selected some additional lights to be included in my HomeKit config followed by clicking `Submit`, the error `Unknown error occurred` was shown on the dialog.

Some logs are below with the error `TypeError: 'KeyError' object is not iterable`

I tried creating a new HomeKit instance for my Lights domain, in the case that something in HA was corrupt, but the same issue arises.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.1

It looks like there is an integration that has a problem fetching the device triggers and is throwing a KeyError exception as a result.

Looks like we will probably need to trap that and log the backtrace to prevent it from leaking into HomeKit
Here is a fix. Still need to add a test https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/55639

review_comments: Is `return_exceptions=True` no longer required for this?

We need `return_exceptions` to be `True` for the multi-device case so we can use the ones that are working.

We need `return_exceptions` to be `False` for the single device case since we know we can raise given it won't affect fetching the other devices
